Software Engineer II - ServiceNow Developer & ITSM
ServiceNow Senior Developer
description:
Job Title
ServiceNow Senior Developer,070
Experience
3–5 years
Location
Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Gurgaon, Pune, Thiruvananthapuram
(Hybrid model – 3 days work from office)
Employment Type
Full-time
Salary Range
INR 22,00,000 – 24,00,000 per annum
Notice Period
Immediate to 15 days only
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled 
ServiceNow Senior Developer
 with strong expertise in 
ITOM, ITSM, and Cloud Management
 modules. The role involves designing, developing, and optimizing IT operations solutions, automating workflows, and enhancing infrastructure visibility and performance across enterprise environments.
Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and implement solutions using ServiceNow ITOM modules, including:
Event Management 
Discovery 
Service Mapping 
Cloud Management 
Orchestration 
Collaborate with stakeholders, IT teams, and business analysts to gather and analyze requirements for IT operations automation and optimization. 
Develop and configure workflows, business rules, scripts, and integrations to automate IT operations and monitoring. 
Configure and maintain service maps, event rules, monitoring tools, and integrations with external monitoring systems. 
Lead the development of custom ServiceNow enhancements to improve efficiency and reduce manual operational effort. 
Perform troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and issue resolution related to ITOM implementations and integrations. 
Mentor and guide junior developers, promoting best practices in ServiceNow development. 
Maintain clear and accurate documentation for all configurations, custom developments, and integrations. 
Work closely with ITSM, Cloud, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless end-to-end IT operations. 
Stay current with the latest ServiceNow ITOM features and best practices and apply them to ongoing projects. 
Mandatory Skills & Certifications
Strong hands-on experience in ServiceNow ITOM 
Strong hands-on experience in ServiceNow ITSM 
ServiceNow CSA Certification (mandatory) 
ServiceNow CIS Certification (ITSM & ITOM – mandatory) 
Senior-level experience in ServiceNow Development 
Experience with Cloud Management within ServiceNow 
Senior Developer Skill Set
ServiceNow ITOM 
ServiceNow ITSM 
ServiceNow Development (Advanced/Senior level) 
Cloud Management integrations 
Additional Requirements
High job stability is mandatory 
Ability to work in a hybrid environment (3 days onsite) 
Interview Process
2 Technical Rounds 
1 Client / Stakeholder Round 
Skills: cloud,management,servicenow,it
